chapter: Taped excerpts: friends, family and facts
title: Rosamond Johnson and his choir
summary: Johnson says Rosamond Johnson was a good friend and qualified voice instructor who assembled his own choir.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Well, now, you mentioned James Weldon Johnson's brother to me once on one of our visits.
You talked about him with a choir. And you've mentioned that you were good friends with him.
The choir was (inaudible). He assembled his own choir.
He was a very qualified musician, voice instructor.
Uh-huh. Was this -- where did this choir sing, in churches or in public?
Oh, (inaudible). They might sing in different places, I imagine.
